events.content:
The dashboard page now renders its heading immediately and places the API fetch behind a local Suspense boundary. That lets Next.js pre-render the heading and fallback as the page shell while dashboard data loads.

I added a dashboard-shaped skeleton with reduced-motion support, and reused it in the route loading state so both fallbacks are consistent. `git diff --check` passed; I didn’t run the build or tests.
